content.short: Marlin Protocol is an open infrastructure protocol enabling sharing of excess hardware with developers, offering integrity-protected jobs and zk-based prover computations.
content.description: Marlin Protocol is a global infrastructure designed to power high-performance decentralized networks through a bandwidth-sharing marketplace. As an open protocol, it allows participants who have surplus compute capacity to contribute their resources to application developers. The system provides integrity-protected job execution, zk-based prover computations, event-driven scheduling actions, caching services, and the transmission of blocks and transactions across supported networks.
content.meta: Marlin Protocol enables high-performance decentralized networks via bandwidth sharing. Discover Marlin Protocol and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
